$comment: Per-contract showcase-navigation decisions read by scripts/build-wordpress-showcase-nav.mjs, checked against the raw markup in each contract's navigation-source.json. hide/keep name a navigation entry by navigation id (or templatePart for an inline navigation), label, and pageId and path (labels from the top entry down) when the label alone is not unique; subtree: true takes a submenu with everything it holds, except a sign-in, account or search screen not named by its own entry. repoint moves a template part's navigation block from one wp_navigation to another; removeBlock drops the one block of a template part that block {name, anchor, className, ref, contains} matches. Every entry carries the reason. Contracts not listed use the automatic rule alone.
